seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The newly formed party takes courier and investigation work across Hallia, uncovering a conspiracy of Ugathul impostors, Embercall radar dishes, and illegal augury — culminating in a descent into the sewers and discovery of Master Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the city.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves three party members dead, sending Johnny and Benny's souls into the void between life and death where they meet the entity Aut. Resurrected but diminished, the party regroups and exacts brutal revenge on the half-giant Hlarf.

seasons.title: The Poncho Gang Goes Hunting
seasons.arc_summary: Fresh off Hlarf's death, the party hunts Tywelwyn Leatherhide through his fiery Fane, discovers a sentient heart revealing six alien gods attempting to breach Færrin via radar dishes, and reports the conspiracy to both the Magical Crimes Convox and the Inquisition — only to find Detective Brooks abducted when they investigate.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Rescuing Anaïs unveils the cosmic Narrative — five sibling entities including the party's patron Aut — and launches a keystone scavenger hunt at a massive pilgrimage gathering, where the party survives a gladiatorial trial, solves puzzles, assassinates a rival demon, and trades a stolen painting to a transit Heart to secure their first keystone.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns from death as only half a man, and after months of downtime the party discovers a hairline fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run — a parallel world where a two-mile-tall imprisoned god looms behind the firmament. They uncover a vast conspiracy to shatter the barrier and bomb the research facility, triggering a catastrophic collapse.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party joins the pilgrimage aboard a colossal arachnid Strider city, creates their own heart named Eerie, forges a coalition of factions to survive weekly tithes of magical energy, and delves deep into the Undercroft to ally with the ancient Machine God — purging Herald cultists and building defenses for the long voidward journey.

seasons.title: The Sleeping Clan and the Menhir
seasons.arc_summary: The party assaults the Herald's sleeping clan in a pristine hospital stronghold, poisons its corrupted heart, and makes a fateful bargain with the Menhir — a member of the cosmic Narrative — only to accidentally destroy them with a god-killing revolver, stranding the Strider on a dead world far off the known map.

seasons.title: Stranded
seasons.arc_summary: Stranded on a scoured, godless horizon, the party negotiates a fragile ceasefire with Grayson, frees a half-minotaur gunslinger from the Herald's mental control via a dangerous mindscape dive, battles corrupted Harlequins in the Strider's spire, and pursues Anzu's sister Galzu through surreal memory-vignettes into the Fane of Tali.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Fall of the Terror
seasons.arc_summary: Four 8th-grade heroes descend into the lair beneath Mt. Cagley and slay the shadow demon known as the Terror of Cagley, concluding the Cagley Middle one-shot as the town is saved (though the heroes are in hot water with their parents).

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: High-ranking Scale operatives investigate a slip-shielded structure on a shattered Joker World, fighting through the fiend-built Quorum to discover and liberate the Voice of Many — a trapped divine entity and grandchild of the Judge — in a desperate ten-round defense before teleporting home.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Three Convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate a string of husk-murders linked to the Verdant Expanse, following a Feyrock necklace into a mile-tall forest where they battle fey creatures and discover a deeper curse at work. The trail leads them back to the city of Hallia, where they uncover the Gloaming Codex and are pulled into its pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station sunken in the slip, uncovering a Thessian named Gremory (now 'Esoterica') who tortured the station's AI and accessed records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: The fire team is pulled from retirement for a desperate raid on the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian 'Tithe,' navigating slip puzzles and spider temples to become the only team to successfully plant a beacon before the God Eater Harrow consumes everything.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
